description:
Day 5 - 5th October – Science Competition at Wilson High School (Junior and Senior Students), C P Tank.
What an inspiring day of innovation, curiosity and creativity! Our Science Project Competition brought together 128 young minds from 12 schools, who impressed us with their fascinating experiments, imaginative ideas and enthusiasm for learning. The Science & Technology Exhibition gave the students yet another wonderful platform to showcase their creativity and talent.
A huge thank you to our Project Directors, Rtn. Shiv Prasad Khator and Rtn. Navanath Panaskar, for their dedication and energy in making Youth Month such a vibrant and memorable experience.
Beneficiaries 128 students
Project cost Rs 20,000/-
